description:
Calculate the convex hull of all populated places in Australia and report its area.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the 'ne_10m_populated_places_simple' shapefile from /home/ga/GIS_Data/natural_earth/.
3. Filter or select the features where the 'SOV0NAME' field is 'Australia'.
4. Generate the Convex Hull for these Australian points. You can use 'Vector > Geoprocessing Tools > Convex Hull' (or Minimum Bounding Geometry). Ensure you create a single polygon for the whole country (if using Minimum Bounding Geometry, do not group; if using Convex Hull, you may need to select the Australian features first or run on a filtered layer).
5. Export the resulting convex hull polygon as a GeoJSON file to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/australia_convex_hull.geojson. Use WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
6. Calculate the area of this convex hull polygon in square kilometers. You can use the Field Calculator ($area / 1000000 with an ellipsoidal measurement) or the Measure Tool.
7. Create a text file at /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/australia_hull_report.txt and write the area value inside (e.g., 'Area: 7500000 sq km').
